statusDefinitions.GREEN: Verified through meaningful automated or real runtime evidence on this platform.
statusDefinitions.YELLOW: Implemented or available, but still needs platform-specific beta validation or an external dependency.
statusDefinitions.RED: Broken or a blocker for the stated platform beta track.
statusDefinitions.GRAY: Not implemented for this distribution target or not sufficiently tested to claim support.

platforms.label: Windows desktop
platforms.architecture: Electron 37 x64 desktop package using the shared browser editor and a localhost provider bridge.
runtimeRequirements: Windows x64
WebView capabilities bundled by Electron
User storage for localStorage and IndexedDB
evidence: tests/windows-beta-readiness.cjs: clean installed-app journey with real WebM, PNG and WAV
tests/windows-runtime-smoke.cjs: packaged runtime, playback, Vanessa Steps 7-25 and valid WebM export
installer-dist/Zorifi-Setup-3.37.0.exe and release/Zorifi-win32-x64/Zorifi.exe
ZORIFI-BETA-READINESS-3.37.0.md
knownLimitations: Provider-backed AI generation needs separately configured credentials/services.
Physical microphone, touchscreen and OS fullscreen remain manual checks.
MP4/4K availability depends on runtime codec and hardware support.

platforms.label: macOS desktop
platforms.architecture: Shared Electron 37 desktop runtime with Intel and Apple-silicon DMG/ZIP targets, macOS lifecycle handling, Keychain-backed safeStorage and signed-build entitlements.
runtimeRequirements: macOS build runner for DMG creation, signing and notarization
Supported Intel or Apple-silicon Mac
Browser media codecs bundled with Electron
evidence: package.json defines x64/arm64 DMG and ZIP targets
electron-main.cjs preserves the Darwin activate/window lifecycle and uses operating-system safeStorage
build/entitlements.mac.plist declares camera, microphone and local-provider network entitlements
Cross-platform packaging configuration tests pass
knownLimitations: No macOS hardware/runtime session was available in the Windows development environment.
Apple signing credentials and notarization are not configured in source code and must be supplied securely on the macOS release runner.
Final import/playback/export, permission and keyboard validation is required on both Intel and Apple-silicon hardware.
automatedTests: npm run package:macos on a macOS runner
manualTests: Keychain, camera, microphone and keyboard shortcuts

platforms.label: Web/PWA
platforms.architecture: Static PWA build with service worker, manifest, Netlify functions and browser-local storage.
runtimeRequirements: HTTPS for install, microphone, camera and service worker
Modern browser with IndexedDB, Web Audio, Canvas captureStream and MediaRecorder
evidence: npm run build:web creates web-dist from the production allowlist
manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, netlify.toml and _redirects are present
Responsive and platform-neutral suites pass
knownLimitations: No current Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox runtime matrix was executed.
Storage is browser/device-local and subject to quota/eviction.
Export formats and resolution depend on MediaRecorder codecs.
Install UI depends on browser PWA support.
manualTests: Provider and support functions on deployed HTTPS origin

platforms.label: iPhone web/PWA
platforms.architecture: Purpose-built responsive mobile web UI selected by iPhone/mobile detection; no native iOS binary.
runtimeRequirements: Current iOS Safari or installed web app
HTTPS
Available browser storage and media APIs
evidence: app.js detects iPhone/mobile and selects mobile editor
styles.css has safe-area, touch-first dock, tool sheets and portrait/landscape rules
tests/zorifi-responsive-redesign.test.cjs validates mobile wiring
knownLimitations: No real iPhone runtime session was executed.
No App Store/native package.
iOS storage eviction, backgrounding and MediaRecorder/export limitations need device validation.
Wake-word behavior depends on browser speech/microphone policy.

platforms.label: iPad web/PWA
platforms.architecture: Dedicated tablet mode selected by iPad/desktop-touch detection; no native iPadOS binary.
runtimeRequirements: Current iPadOS Safari or installed web app
HTTPS
Available browser storage and media APIs
evidence: app.js detects iPad including MacIntel with multiple touch points
styles.css includes tablet workspace rules
Phase 9 and responsive suites validate tablet selectors
knownLimitations: No real iPad runtime or Apple Pencil test.
No App Store/native package.
Hardware keyboard and drag/drop need manual verification.
Browser storage and export have Safari-specific constraints.

platforms.label: Android web/PWA
platforms.architecture: Purpose-built responsive mobile web UI with PWA installation; no APK/AAB or Play Store package.
runtimeRequirements: Current Chrome/Edge Android
HTTPS
Available browser storage and media APIs
evidence: app.js detects Android Mobile
styles.css has safe-area/cutout-friendly mobile rules and touch controls
Manifest and service worker provide the PWA path
Export fallback explicitly targets recent Chrome/Edge on Android/Windows
knownLimitations: No real Android device runtime was executed.
No native APK/AAB.
OEM codec, memory pressure and file-picker behavior vary.
Wake word and background processing are constrained by browser policy.

platforms.label: Linux desktop/web
platforms.architecture: Shared Electron 37 desktop runtime with x64 AppImage and Debian targets, browser editor, localhost provider bridge and Linux keyring-aware safeStorage.
runtimeRequirements: 64-bit Linux with GTK 3 and Electron runtime dependencies
GNOME Keyring/libsecret or KWallet for provider credential storage
FUSE support for direct AppImage launch or AppImage extraction fallback
evidence: package.json defines x64 AppImage and deb targets
electron-main.cjs rejects Electron basic_text credential storage and accepts supported Linux keyrings
Linux target declares GTK, NSS, X11 helper, accessibility, UUID and libsecret dependencies
Cross-platform packaging configuration tests pass
knownLimitations: No Linux desktop session was available in the Windows development environment, so Wayland/X11 runtime behavior remains unverified.
The Debian package targets Debian/Ubuntu-compatible distributions; other distributions should use AppImage.
Final codec, sandbox, keyring, file picker, playback and export validation is required on real Linux systems.
